name: latin
note: Latin strings across the engine's primary registered face (Noto Sans) at multiple sizes plus the family's synthetic bold/italic via font-shorthand weight/style, and the same pangram on five additional registered Latin faces. Covers sizing, uppercase/lowercase, digits, ligatures, kerning, punctuation, and whitespace characters.
